summary.result: The water vision 2020 reported only direct water for live animal, but the water footprint includes the direct and indirect water.
summary.background: Since the consumption of the livestock products increased for the past 10 years in Korea, the water use for live animals has become more important in terms of water savings.
summary.method: The water footprint of beef cattle was calculated to $17,023.1m^3/ton$ , and direct water was $91.2m^3/ton$ , and indirect water was $16,931.9m^3/ton$ .
